name: Accelerated Charged Particle Repeater Gun
description: The Accelerated Charged Particle Repeater Gun, commonly known as the ACP repeater gun, Trandoshan Chopper or Nar Shaddaa Grinder, was a medium-range blaster manufactured by Arakyd Industries. It was popular amongst criminals, most notably the Trandoshan mercenary group. These guns were not at all advanced and had built-in extinguishers in case of overheating.
